lines.text: Your coding agent just hit a fork in the road, and you are nowhere near your terminal.
So the agent simply stops, and waits for you.
Every hour it waits is an hour of work that does not happen.
With Agent R Q, every request your agents make lands on one task board, in real time.
Ongoing, waiting, blocked, done. Every status is visible in one place.
Open it on your phone, wherever you are, and read the question in full.
Then just answer, in plain words. Wait for the weekend, and do the indexes first.
The agent picks up your reply instantly, with no refresh and no copy and paste.
Or the agent needs permission. An approval card shows exactly what it wants to run.
Allow once, always allow, or deny. You stay in control of every command.
Approved, and the agent carries straight on with the job.
You never miss a request, and no agent ever stays stuck for long.
Which request from an agent do you miss most often? Let us know below, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
